guide.title: Zhaoyang Village

source.author: A_Backdated_Future
source.source_file: raw-sources/Shadow Hearts - Guide and Walkthrough - PlayStation 2 - By A_Backdated_Future - GameFAQs.html

save_points: Center of town, near the well
objectives: Explore **Zhaoyang Village** and collect hidden items
Gather the **Metal Bowl** and **Torch** to use with **Anti-Cat Powder**
Defeat the **Felinus** sub-boss in the pit house
Prepare the party to **Level 6** and defeat **Yamaraja: Earth**
Acquire the **Shell Bracelet** and **Snake Card** before departing to **Fengtian**

bosses.name: Yamaraja: Earth
bosses.strategy:
- Note that **Yamaraja: Earth** is actually a **WATER class**.
- As I mentioned above, he's pretty dangerous! If you can't beat him, level up in town for a while before trying again. I recommend at least **Level 6** for everyone.
- His **Flash Flood** will hit an ally for pretty good damage, while his **Large Whirlpool** will hit your entire party for major damage, as well as possibly halving your **Hit Area** on your **Judgment Ring**, so be sure to heal after it hits.
- His physical attacks are also nothing to sneeze at, as they can take away large chunks of HP at a time.
- Make sure that **Alice** and **Zhuzhen** are in the back row, and when in doubt, just heal.
- Have **Yuri** fuse into the **Raging Tiger** and use his **Flying Stones** attack, followed by normal attacks.
- Have **Alice** stay on healing duty the entire time, and have **Zhuzhen** cast **Ogre Flamedance** continuously.
- If needed, have Yuri supplement healing since Zhuzhen's fire magic probably hits for more than Yuri does, and make sure to keep Alice from becoming **Berserk**.

steps.description:
1. When you regain control, head back south to the **first area of town** to find an **Angel's Feather** roughly around the center of the area, just to the lower-right of a pile of sticks.
2. Go back up to the previous screen (**second area**), then follow along the right side until you see the '?' icon near another pile of sticks to find a **Bronze Arrowhead**.
3. Continue north to the next area.

1. Use the **Save Point** in the center of town near the well to save your game and clear **Malice** in the **Graveyard** if needed.
2. Check around the right side of the well by a board on the ground to find a **Tent**.
3. Go all the way to the right, then all the way up to the corner by the **Lost Peddler / Wandering Merchant** to find a **Talisman of Luck** lying on the ground.

Shop with the **Wandering Merchant** if desired.

- Prioritize healing supplies such as **Thera**, **Mana**, and **Pure Leaves**.
- **Pure Leaves** are especially helpful because Alice has low SP and can easily become **Berserk**.
- If you have extra funds, purchase **Leather Belts** and **Bandannas** (up to 3 each for the active party) and equip both on **Yuri** and **Alice** before proceeding.

1. Head all the way north to the next area to reach the **shrine**.
2. Watch the events here, then enter the house the children invite you to and watch the scene.
3. After some rest, take on two **Hellcats** in combat.

boss.name: Hellcat x2
boss.strategy: They're not too bad; just have **Yuri** fuse into the **Raging Tiger** and wail on them with regular attacks while **Alice** keeps both of you healed with either **Cure** or **Thera Leaves**.

steps.description: After defeating the Hellcats, head back into the house and examine the dresser at the very top of the screen to find a **Phoenix Tail**.

1. Go back outside and make your way north back to the **shrine**.
2. After a scene with the **Cat Lady**, head back to the previous area and go to the left side of the well to encounter her again.
3. Head south to the **second area** to run into her yet again, then continue south back to the **first area**.
In the **first area**, run into the Quack Oracle, who introduces himself as Master **Li Zhuzhen**, and meet Wanderer **Meiyuan** the acupuncturist. **Zhuzhen** temporarily joins your party.

notes.title: Zhuzhen Equipment & Meiyuan Acupuncture
notes.text:
- **Zhuzhen** comes equipped with an **Oak Staff** and a **Cotton Shirt** by default.
- As for **Meiyuan**, he can't fight, but his acupuncture allows you to increase the **Attack Power** of your weapon, the **Hit Area** on the **Judgment Ring**, or both.
- It costs a lot of money to do it at this point, so I don't recommend it. We'll be able to buy new weapons in the next town which will be stronger anyway.
- However, if you're having trouble hitting areas on the **Judgment Ring**, then by all means, try to increase the **Hit Area** if you can afford it.
- NOTE: If you want to see how much it would cost to power up your weapons, check out section A-1-08 for the cost for every weapon in the game.

steps.description:
1. Continue north to encounter the **Cat Lady** once more, then return to the center of town to see her again, and finally re-enter the house you were originally lured into.
2. After the scene, learn that you need to find a **Metal Vessel** and a **Torch** to combine with the **Anti-Cat Powder** received from **Zhuzhen**.
Head back outside and make your way south to the **second area**. Follow along the western side until the '?' icon pops up, then complete a **Normal Ring** execution to pick up the **Metal Bowl**.
Continue south to the entrance and examine the building just to the right of **Meiyuan** to find the **Torch** among a pile of sticks.

With both required items collected, make your way back to the center of town and use the **Save Point**. When ready, enter the Cat Lady's house and examine the pit in the center to trigger the battle with **Felinus**.

boss.name: Felinus
boss.strategy:
- This lady isn't to be taken lightly. She can use the **Wind Fang** ability to hit everyone for Wind damage, and after a couple of turns, your whole party will be in need of healing, so beware.
- Since she's a **Wind class**, have **Yuri** fuse into the **Raging Tiger** and use the **Flying Stones** skill to do some decent damage to her, followed by regular attacks.
- **Alice** should be keeping everyone healed, as should **Zhuzhen**.
- If no one needs healing then, have **Zhuzhen** use his **Ogre Flamedance** spell, and **Alice** should attack normally.
- As long as you stay healed and don't let Alice go **Berserk**, you should be fine.

steps.description: Head back to the **Save Point** and use a **Tent** to recover party HP and MP before attempting the boss.

notes.title: Level Recommendation & Boss Preparation
notes.text:
- This next boss is REALLY tough if you're at a low level.
- I strongly recommend fighting until everyone in your party is at least **Level 6** before continuing on; it should only take a few battles.
- If you get some extra money, those **Leather Belts** and **Bandannas** for everyone would probably be a good idea.

steps.description: Head back north to the **shrine** and examine it. You are prompted: *'Do you dare violate the shrine?'*

choices.outcome: Initiates the boss battle against Yamaraja: Earth.

steps.description: Choose option [2] to fight the boss: **Yamaraja: Earth** (#010 Yamaraja: Earth, HP: 300, Class: Water).

steps.description: After the battle and scene conclude, examine the shrine once again to find a **Shell Bracelet**. Then head south through town and speak with the **Lost Peddler** on the second screen to obtain the **Snake Card**.

notes.title: Remove Zhuzhen's Equipment
notes.text: After the battle, remove everything you can from **Zhuzhen** before leaving town.

notes.title: Snake Card Guild Discount
notes.text: The **Snake Card** is a **Guild Card** that can be used for a discount in Shops.

steps.description: Make your way to the town gate, where **Zhuzhen** departs from your party. Exit to the **World Map** and proceed to your next destination: **Fengtian**.
